State Of Wisconsin Investment Board Has Upped Its Position in Discovery INC (DISCK) by $3.25 Million as Stock Rose Posted by Winifred Garcia 9:55 pm
State Of Wisconsin Investment Board increased its stake in Discovery Inc (DISCK) by 0.9% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. State Of Wisconsin Investment Board bought 130,014 shares as the company’s stock rose 22.56% with the market. The institutional investor held 14.57M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $371.47M, up from 14.44 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. State Of Wisconsin Investment Board who had been investing in Discovery Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $20.29 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.86% or $0.5 $26.4. About 4.13M shares traded or 36.56% up from the average. Discovery, Inc. (NASDAQ:DISCK) has risen 43.45% since December 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 27.83% the S&P500.
State Of Wisconsin Investment Board, which manages about $34.77B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd (NYSE:RCL) by 58,948 shares to 241,698 shares, valued at $25.04M in 2018Q2, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 295,339 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 5.89 million shares, and cut its stake in Southern Co (NYSE:SO).
Another recent and important Discovery, Inc. (NASDAQ:DISCK) news was published by Nasdaq.com which published an article titled: “U.S. STOCKS ON THE MOVE-AMD, Wynn, Discovery, Twitter – Nasdaq” on December 03, 2018.
